description: This file defines the ExpenseRepository class which acts as an abstraction layer for database operations related to expenses, including handling transactions, budgets, and categories within a Flutter app. It interacts with various DAOs and manages database initialization and data fetching.

classes.name: ExpenseRepository
classes.description: Provides methods for initializing and interacting with expense-related data in the database, including fetching monthly data and updating budgets.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database connection, seeds data if necessary, and sets up DAO instances.

methods.name: currentMonth
methods.description: Returns the current month in 'YYYY-MM' format.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Fetches the list of months with available transaction data.

methods.name: monthTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total expenses for a given month.

methods.name: monthCategoryBreakdown
methods.description: Provides a category-wise sum of expenses for a specific month.

methods.name: transactionsForMonth
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions for a specified month.

methods.name: budgetsForMonth
methods.description: Fetches budget data along with spent amounts for a specific month.

methods.name: setBudget
methods.description: Creates or updates a budget entry for a specific category in a particular month.

methods.name: allCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all expense categories with their details.
